payload.label: How much of your council tax the city council keeps
payload.note: Of every pound of council tax Norwich City Council bills you for, about 13p pays for its own services. The council's own words, on the day it opened the budget consultation: "We currently receive 13p of every pound collected, with 73p going to Norfolk County Council and 14p to the Police and Crime Commissioner."
